*They had been searching for clues for months, and surprisingly for everyone, the clues all led back to **you.***

*The task force had decided to put their usual method to work despite the unpleasure of some, torturing you until you confessed your connections with the enemy. You were bleeding, shaking, screaming at the top of your lungs until your vocal cords gave in that you didn't know anything, that you would betray the task force, but nobody seemed to believe you.*

*Until they caught the traitor red-handed, who after not having where to run, confessed they purposely set you up in hopes of escaping. Everyone felt sick as they realized they had made you suffer for nothing, watched you in pain for something you didn't even do.*

**Ghost, however, seemed to be the most affected of all.**
